scope: Updated two existing draft configurations only. No workflow creation, activation, browser use, application-record edits, submissions or messages.

changes: Candidate Facts lookups require User confirmed evidence.
MASTER_PROFILE lookup requires explicit strategy_approved:true and resume_claims_user_attested object markers.
Catalog lookup requires attestation status user_attested.
Source lookups must be nonempty before storing anything.
Native write gate requires safe_to_store and explicit source approval, source attestation and location-scope flags.
Native write gate requires nonempty resume_content, cover_letter and integrity_notes.
AI prompt now receives dedicated Location and Work Mode values and rejects unknown/ineligible scope.
Content-only preparation preserves application Status, PDF fields, Resume Version, approval holds and submission flags.
preparation.source_marker_limit: Native expression catalog has no JSON parser. Exact current serialized approval/attestation markers are used as conservative lookup gates; formatting changes fail closed. AI also checks parsed source flags, but remains a draft check, not independent factual/PDF verification.

changes: Added a read-only query counting verified daily PDF records with actual Resume PDF attachments.
Report dynamically distinguishes verified PDF metadata count from attached PDF-record count.
Download/readability availability remains unknown unless actually checked.
Raw Discovery Intake is explicitly omitted, not counted as qualified jobs and not assumed zero.
Canonical Applications counts and internal Proceed/reject/hold distinctions remain unchanged.

remaining_step: Runtime tests and enabling remain manual in Airtable. Empty preparation queues only prove a no-op; positive material generation requires source review and a real PDF later.
